reviews.comment: Phenomenal aroma! The pods are large and bursting with seeds. Brewed with afternoon chai and the difference from supermarket cardamom is night and day.
Powers my MacBook Pro and Pixel 8 simultaneously without heating up. Compact enough to carry in my jacket pocket.
The khadi weave is soft, authentic, and supremely breathable in Bengaluru weather. Stitching is immaculate.
The deckle-edge handmade paper handles fountain pen inks with zero bleed or feathering. Truly archival quality.
Earthy terracotta planter with excellent drainage. Arrived carefully wrapped with not a single chip.
Gentle on skin and does not strip moisture. Lasts a good 3-4 weeks of daily use. Highly recommended apothecary!
